extraction.notes: IRT reports FFO and CFFO (Core FFO equivalent) but no AFFO metric; affo fields left null. Diluted share count uses weighted-average shares and OP units (241,342,036) converted to thousands; it reproduces $0.28 for both FFO (68,568/241,342) and CFFO (66,641/241,342). The 'Loan (premium accretion) discount amortization, net' line relates to loans receivable rather than debt, so it was classed as 'other' rather than debt_cost_amortization. Recurring capex of $12.4 million is stated in the text on page 4 (rounded to $12,400 thousand from the printed $12.4 million); it is the total portfolio figure for the quarter. Same-page three-month column used; the FFO/CFFO reconciliation appears on printed page 12 (also trailing-five-quarter table on page 11 agrees).
